name: get_resource_enrollment_status
description:
Fetches the enrollment status for a project in Audit Manager.
Format: 'projects/{project}/locations/{location}/resourceEnrollmentStatuses/-'. CRITICAL: For {location}, use the location specified by the user. If no location is specified, prompt the user to provide one. Do not use 'global'. The location must match the chosen regional endpoint (REP) region (for example, us-central1).
